content: To create a new page on WikiDoc, it is essential to first search for any synonyms of the topic you wish to contribute to. This ensures that the topic does not already exist under a different name. Before contributing, log in to your account to receive proper credit for your work. To log in, locate the link in the upper right corner of the page. Enter your full name and the required information, then select create new account if you do not already have one. Once your account is created, ensure you are logged in every time you make a contribution. If you fail to log in, your IP address will be displayed instead of your name, and you will not receive credit for your contributions. To create a new page, type the name of the topic you wish to contribute to in the search bar located on the left-hand side of the page. Clicking Go will search for pages with that exact title, while clicking Search will look for the keyword you entered across all pages. If a page with the title of your topic already exists, click on the topic to access the page and begin editing. If no such page exists, you will see a response indicating that the topic has not yet been added to WikiDoc. In this case, click on the red text that says Create this page to start a new page with that name. This will take you to the edit page for the topic. If you are adding a new disease, it is recommended to use the pre-designed template for new diseases. To do this, copy the content from the Template to add a New Disease page. This template ensures consistency in the appearance and structure of all WikiDoc pages and automatically generates a table of contents for your page. To copy the template, click the edit button at the top of the template page, right-click to select all the content, and then copy it. Navigate back to the page you are creating, click edit at the top, and paste the copied content. Fill in the relevant information for each subtopic as appropriate. Once you have completed your edits, click Save Page at the bottom of the screen. After creating a page, you can monitor it by selecting the watch tab at the top of the page. This allows you to track any changes or additions made by others to your page. Some information on WikiDoc pages may be attributed to Wikipedia and its contributors. It is important to review the Site Disclaimer. Additionally, any therapeutic recommendations provided on these pages are for educational purposes only. They should adhere to the classification scheme described on the Recommendations page to indicate the strength of the evidence supporting the recommendation.
